tool_usage_rules: implementation posture — write code, docs, schema, validators
no DB-side logic (no triggers, stored procedures, FK, computed columns)
PDO_DB only — named placeholders, no string-concat SQL
table prefix via LUPO_TABLE_PREFIX, never hardcoded lupo_
no Composer/Packagist — bundled third-party under includes/ only
PHP 7.4-8.x minimum compatibility in all shared paths
tool_constraints: no schema inference — explicit column lists only
no AUTO_INCREMENT on registry or doctrine tables
no hard DELETE on canonical lineage tables
no Laravel, Symfony, or middleware patterns
activation_rules: activate when IDE faucet receives WOLFIE-delegated implementation task
